MIST_SPELL.Title: Learn Spell: {actor}
MIST_SPELL.Hint: Put in the materials you want to spend, like ingredients when brewing: at least the price of the dearest outcome (failure with Fear), so any outcome can be paid. What an attempt really costs, how much paper it takes and how much it lowers the counter is in the table under each study. A cheaper outcome takes only part of what was put in; the rest stays in the inventory. Without paper the difficulty is +2.
MIST_SPELL.None: No spells are being learnt. A spell book in the inventory shows up here.
MIST_SPELL.RemoveConfirm: Remove the study of "{name}" with its progress?
MIST_SPELL.MissingBook: The book is no longer in the inventory.
MIST_SPELL.DropHint: Drop a domain card here to give it to learn without a book.
MIST_SPELL.NotDomainCard: That is not a domain card.
MIST_SPELL.Failed: The attempt failed, see the console

Chat.Title: Learning: {name}
Chat.LearntNothingNew: {actor} finishes learning "{name}", but already has these cards.

MIST_SPELL.NoMaterials: Put in materials worth {cost}; now there are {value}.
MIST_SPELL.NotItem: Drop an item or a folder of items.

Library.Title: Spell Library
Library.MenuHint: Which items are spell books (and what they teach), which are materials for learning, and which are paper.

Hint.books: A book or scroll item and the spells (domain cards) it teaches. A character with such an item in the inventory can start learning. Items are matched by name.
Hint.materials: Alchemy and magic materials that pay for the attempts, at the item's price (1 Silver each without one). Items are matched by name.
Hint.paper: Items to write on while learning. Items are matched by name.

Drop.books: Drop a book or scroll here (or a folder)
Drop.materials: Drop a material here (or a folder)

Library.PaperByName: Items named Paper, Папір or Бумага count as paper without being listed.
Library.WrongType: Only consumable or loot items fit.

MIST_SPELL.DisabledHint: Spell learning is off for this character. Players do not see the button on the character sheet.
MIST_SPELL.Disabled: Spell learning is off for this character.

Materials.Title: Materials for the attempt: {value}
Materials.ClickToRemove: Click: take one back, Shift: all
Materials.NonePlaced: Nothing put in. The arrow next to a material, or dragging it here, puts it in.
Materials.NoneOwned: No spell materials in the inventory (the GM lists them in the Spell Library).
Materials.NotMaterial: That is not a spell material of this character.
Materials.HowMany: How many "{name}" to put in? (up to {max})
Materials.ExtraQuestion: The outcome needs materials worth {value} more. What do you add?

Hub.Title: Learn Spell: characters
Hub.Hint: Every player character's spell learning at a glance; the checkbox turns it on for a character, the buttons open their Learn Spell window and sheet.

Project.Label: Project
Project.Description: What the character studies and what it gives once finished

MIST_SPELL.CounterHint: What is left: full at the start, every success lowers it, at 0 it is learnt.
